claim: Conversational shopping can compress research and comparison into one interface
countervailingForce: Specialist purchases still require validation and fulfilment
leadingIndicator: Share of qualified actions initiated by AI referrals
commercialImplication: Generic comparison visits and affiliate clicks are exposed
limitations: Platform availability does not establish UK adoption or conversion

claim: Merchants can provide product feeds directly to agent platforms
countervailingForce: Independent evidence may still influence the decision
leadingIndicator: Merchant feed coverage and agent-originated checkout share
commercialImplication: Feed-only intermediaries can be absent from the measurable path
limitations: Commercial compensation and UK coverage remain unsettled

claim: Cheap generated descriptions and guides expand the supply of commodity product content
countervailingForce: Search policies penalise scaled low-value output and buyers may prefer trusted evidence
leadingIndicator: Index growth versus assisted actions for generic pages
commercialImplication: Generic editorial loses scarcity and may cost more to maintain than it earns
limitations: The size of the supply increase is not measured here

claim: Generated product text and images create provenance and labelling work
countervailingForce: Machine-readable labels do not prove factual accuracy
leadingIndicator: Merchant Center rejections and product-data correction rate
commercialImplication: Provenance and review controls become operating requirements
limitations: Merchant Center rules do not cover every channel

claim: AI can propose normalisation mappings and detect catalogue discrepancies
countervailingForce: Every mapping still needs source-aware validation
leadingIndicator: Minutes per verified product update and escaped-error rate
commercialImplication: Labour can fall if error rates do not rise

claim: Original tests compatibility rules and outcome evidence become more valuable than generated summaries
countervailingForce: Incumbents can fund similar evidence and some attributes remain public
leadingIndicator: Repeat use corrections citations and paid use of original fields
commercialImplication: Invest upstream in evidence that agents can consume but cannot invent
limitations: Demand and willingness to pay for the data are unproven

claim: Surveys installation servicing and local capacity remain physical
countervailingForce: Agents can improve routing and may connect buyers directly
leadingIndicator: Accepted installed-project leads and completion rate
commercialImplication: Quote-led lanes remain more durable than pure link referral
limitations: Physical delivery can still be low-margin and operationally costly

claim: Synthetic reviews tests and installation images increase the value of disclosed provenance
countervailingForce: Strong merchant brands and platform guarantees may capture the trust layer
leadingIndicator: Buyer use of methodology and provenance fields
commercialImplication: Verified evidence can differentiate if it changes action
limitations: No buyer study for this vertical has been conducted

claim: Feed rights attribution terms and exclusive offers still require merchant relationships
countervailingForce: Large platforms may secure better direct integrations
leadingIndicator: Feed continuity exclusive inventory and non-last-click agreements
commercialImplication: Commercial access matters more as public content commoditises
limitations: No merchant interviews or negotiated terms exist

claim: Reliance on search rankings affiliate cookies or one agent leaves the business exposed
countervailingForce: Direct brand saved projects email and multi-interface distribution reduce concentration
leadingIndicator: Revenue share by platform and direct-return cohort
commercialImplication: Diversify before any single interface controls the buyer

claim: A narrow decision system can remain useful if it owns evidence compatibility and service outcomes
countervailingForce: Horizontal platforms and retailers can copy visible features
leadingIndicator: Share of recommendations using non-public or originally measured inputs
commercialImplication: Proceed only as an evidence and project company
limitations: The moat depends on successful accumulation rather than current possession

claim: A generic buying-guide and comparison-page operation can be reproduced without the proposed publisher
countervailingForce: Brand trust and original testing can preserve some direct use
leadingIndicator: Organic visits and assisted revenue to pages without original inputs
commercialImplication: Do not finance commodity page production as the core asset
limitations: The timing and category variation are uncertain
